intro: Silvery Spinnerets are harvested from the great spider Lady Sathrah in northern Teldrassil. Once used to weave webs that captured healing evening dew for the Temple of the Moon, they are sought by the Priestesses of Elune to honor the fallen creature's soul through a sacred ritual of rebirth.

p: Lady Sathrah was once counted among the favored creatures of Elune, renowned for spinning shimmering webs through the moonlight near Wellspring Lake. Her silver silk gathered the evening mist, forming healing dews prized by the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus. Unfortunately, the corruption creeping through the boughs of Teldrassil did not spare her. Falling into violent madness, Sathrah became a danger to her own brood and the surrounding forest. Priestess A'moora asks travelers to end the spider's suffering and recover her spinnerets as an act of mercy, bringing closure to a revered resident of the great boughs.
